milestones.claim: analyze-batch.mjs offline-adjudicates the four committed evidence streams to a three-state (pass|fail|inconclusive) H1-H4 report.json + report.md
milestones.doneMeans: node analyze-batch.mjs prints the four verdicts + overall + digest and writes report.json + report.md; missing/insufficient evidence yields inconclusive not pass

milestones.claim: the report carries a reproducible digest = sha256(canonicalJson(report minus digest)); re-runs are byte-identical
milestones.doneMeans: two runs on the same inputs produce byte-identical report + digest; no timestamp/random in the digested preimage

milestones.claim: a hermetic selfcheck-m4.mjs proves the three-state logic is un-gameable (tampered/missing evidence -> fail/inconclusive, never false pass) and a Codex host-2 replicates the digest
milestones.doneMeans: node selfcheck-m4.mjs exits 0 selfcheck-m4 PASS; genuine Codex cross-host re-derives the identical digest
